newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga puts back Vigdis restart to July 5.
newsitem.headline: Saga puts back Vigdis restart to July 5.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Thursday it had delayed the restart of the North Sea Vigdis oilfield to July 5. The company said on June 10 that it planned to resume operations at Vigdis at the end of the month.
"We have postponed the start up again, the latest date is July 5," Saga spokesman Bjoern Schibevaag told Reuters. "The gas compressor is at Snorre/Vigdis and it is just the installation now."

Production at the development was closed down on May 23 after a gas leak was detected in the compressor train. The leak was traced back to a design fault in the equipment that had caused damaged to the compressor.
Vigdis, which came on stream in January five months ahead of schedule, suffered an unscheduled shutdown on April 15 due to other problems with the gas compressor.
The field was restarted on May 16. Output was around 50,000 barrels per day (bpd) before the latest incident, but peak output is planned to reach around 75,000 bpd.
Schibevaag said plans for a maintenance turnaround for three weeks in August were still on schedule.
